test_name: Pagination Functionality in Test Suites List
description: Validate that users can navigate through multiple pages of test suites using pagination controls.
steps: Verify the presence of pagination controls at the bottom of the test suites list.
Click the 'Next' button to move to the next page.
Verify that the next page of test suites is displayed.
Click the 'Previous' button to return to the previous page.
Use the 'First' button to navigate to the first page.
Verify the first page is displayed correctly.
Use the 'Last' button to navigate to the last page.
Verify the last page is displayed correctly.
Click on a specific page number to navigate directly to that page.
Verify the content corresponds to the selected page number.
expected_results: Pagination controls navigate correctly between pages.
Content updates dynamically based on the selected page.
First and Last buttons work as expected.
Specific page numbers navigate directly to the correct page.
edge_cases: No test suites exist for a specific page.
Network delay causes pagination to load slowly.
User clicks pagination buttons multiple times quickly.
API fails to fetch data for the selected page.
Pagination controls are disabled or non-functional.
data_requirements: Test suite data distributed across multiple pages.
API endpoints for fetching paginated data.
dependencies: Test suites are distributed across multiple pages.
API endpoints for paginated data are operational.
api_interactions: API call to fetch data for the next page.
API call to fetch data for the previous page.
API call to fetch data for specific page numbers.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load content for each page.
Response time of pagination-related API calls.
UI responsiveness during rapid pagination actions.
accessibility_requirements: Buttons must have ARIA roles and labels.
Ensure focus state is visible on all controls.
